title: Reform accused of targeting the most vulnerable with £50bn benefit cut

paragraphs.en: Reform UK has been accused of excluding the most vulnerable from society and punishing non-Britons living in the UK as it prepared to outline £50bn of cuts to benefits for disabled people and foreign nationals.
paragraphs.zh: 英国改革党（Reform UK）被指责将社会上最脆弱的群体排除在外，并惩罚居住在英国的移民，因为该党准备公布为残疾人和外国人削减500亿英镑福利的计划。

paragraphs.en: Robert Jenrick, Reform’s finance spokesperson, will detail the plans for £20bn of cuts to disability benefits overall, as well as another £21bn from stopping foreign nationals – including EU citizens with settled status – claiming almost any benefits, among other cuts.
paragraphs.zh: 改革党财政事务发言人罗伯特·詹里克（Robert Jenrick）将详细阐述削减残疾福利总计200亿英镑的计划，以及通过停止外国人（包括拥有定居身份的欧盟公民）申领几乎所有福利而再削减210亿英镑，此外还有其他削减措施。

paragraphs.en: The party said the plans were aimed at reducing the welfare bill by a quarter, with personal independence payments (Pip) replaced by another cash benefit that would be restricted to only the “gravely ill and severely challenged”.
paragraphs.zh: 该党表示，这些计划旨在将福利支出削减四分之一，其中个人独立金（Pip）将由另一项现金福利取代，而后者将仅限“重症患者和严重困难者”申领。

paragraphs.en: It said “lower level conditions” would get support overseen by councils and mayors.
paragraphs.zh: 该党称，“程度较轻的病症”将获得由地方议会和市长监督的支援。

paragraphs.en: In relation to foreign nationals, the plans extend proposals set out by Nigel Farage last year in which he claimed that banning migrants from claiming some benefits and scrapping indefinite leave to remain would save £234bn over several decades.
paragraphs.zh: 在外国人问题上，这些计划扩展了奈杰尔·法拉奇（Nigel Farage）去年提出的建议，当时他声称，禁止移民申领某些福利并取消无限期居留权，将在几十年内节省2340亿英镑。

paragraphs.en: Jenrick’s policy paper goes further by stopping foreign-born households claiming universal credit, housing benefit, pension credit, jobseeker’s allowance, child benefit, free childcare, free school meals or disability benefits.
paragraphs.zh: 詹里克的政策文件更进一步，将禁止外国出生的家庭申领全民信贷、住房福利、养老金信贷、求职者津贴、儿童福利、免费托儿、免费校餐或残疾福利。

paragraphs.en: The paper says the change would save the taxpayer £21bn a year by the fifth year of the policy, and would also apply to those with EU settled status. However, foreign-born parents with British-born children would still be eligible for child benefit and free school meals.
paragraphs.zh: 文件称，这项政策实施到第五年，每年将为纳税人节省210亿英镑，并且也适用于拥有欧盟定居身份的人。不过，子女为英国出生的外国出生父母仍可申领儿童福利和免费校餐。

paragraphs.en: Best for Britain, the pro-EU campaign group, said denying benefits to those with indefinite leave to remain would tear up Britain’s EU withdrawal agreement.
paragraphs.zh: 亲欧盟的竞选组织“英国之益”（Best for Britain）表示，剥夺拥有无限期居留权者的福利将撕毁英国的脱欧协议。
